GeneralInformation.StandardReference: Bank of America Reference Guide — Credit and Debit Notification (CAMT.054) — CBPR+ ISO 20022

BusinessContext.Description: Converts SWIFT MT910 (Confirmation of Credit) to ISO 20022 camt.054.001.08 (BankToCustomerDebitCreditNotification). MT910 is the credit-side counterpart of MT900 — sent by a financial institution to confirm to another financial institution that a credit has been made to the sender's account. For MT910: Ntry/CdtDbtInd = CRDT and Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/CdtDbtInd = CRDT (both mandatory at Entry AND Transaction Details level). Per SWIFT CBPR+ roadmap: MT900/MT910 migrate to camt.054 by November 2028.

UseCases.UseCase: Interbank credit confirmation after funds received
Nostro account credit notification to account owner
Settlement confirmation for correspondent banking credits
Reconciliation of credit entries in treasury management systems
Confirmation of incoming cover payment via MT202COV

BusinessContext.ApplicableDomains: Correspondent Banking, Treasury Operations, Nostro Reconciliation, Interbank Settlement, Cash Management, Payments Hub

TechnicalSpecifications.KeyDifference: MT910 carries only credit notifications — the mirror image of MT900. CdtDbtInd = CRDT at BOTH entry level AND transaction details level. Same three new mandatory fields as MT900: NtryRef (NOTPROVIDED), Sts/Cd (BOOK), BkTxCd (NOTPROVIDED). RltdAgts path uses CdtrAgt (not DbtrAgt) since MT910 field :52A: identifies the institution that CREDITED the account — semantically the creditor agent in the underlying transaction from the notified party's perspective.

ComplianceRequirements.Regulation: SWIFT CBPR+ Migration Roadmap — November 2028 for advices
Bank of America Reference Guide — Credit and Debit Notification (CAMT.054)
GDPR — Financial Institution Data Protection (Regulation EU 2016/679)

Variable.description: Fixed NOTPROVIDED — mandatory new camt.054 field Ntry/BkTxCd/Prtry/Cd and Issr

SourceMessage.Standard: SWIFT ISO 15022 — Category 9 (Cash Management and Customer Status)
SourceMessage.MessagePurpose: Sent by an account servicing institution to the account owner or authorised party to confirm that a credit entry has been posted to the account. The credit-side counterpart to MT900. Both are replaced by camt.054 in ISO 20022 — distinguished by CdtDbtInd value (CRDT for MT910, DBIT for MT900).

Field.Description: Unique reference assigned by the sender to identify the MT910 message. Maps to both GrpHdr/MsgId and Ntfctn/Id per BoA reference guide section 1.

ValidationRules.Rule: Unique per sender BIC per calendar day
Maximum 16 characters — SWIFT Character Set X
Must not start or end with / (T26 error code)

Field.Description: Reference of the original transaction that caused the credit. Maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/Refs/InstrId AND EndToEndId. Use NONREF if no related reference is available.
Identification of the credited account. Maps to Ntfctn/Acct/Id (IBAN or Othr) AND Ntfctn/Acct/Ccy.
Date and time of entry posting with UTC offset. Maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/BookgDt/DtTm. Only present when booking date differs from value date. Optional — not always present in MT910.
Value date, currency and amount of the credit entry. Maps to FOUR camt.054 paths: Ntry/Amt, Ntry/ValDt/Dt, TxDtls/Amt, TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt. Also derives Ntfctn/Acct/Ccy.

BIC of the financial institution that sent the funds resulting in this credit. Maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdAgts/CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI. Uses CdtrAgt path (not DbtrAgt) since this institution acted as the crediting party's counterpart in the underlying interbank transfer.
Additional information from sender to receiver. Maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/AddtlTxInf (Max500Text). Content preserved without parsing into separate elements.

Customer that originated the underlying payment being confirmed as credited. Maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdPties/Cdtr/Nm. Uses Cdtr path (not Dbtr) for the same reason FIELD_06 uses CdtrAgt: this party is the crediting side's counterpart in the underlying transfer, kept consistent with the :52A: convention above.
Intermediary bank in the underlying interbank transfer chain. Maps to Ntfctn/Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/RltdAgts/IntrmyAgt1/FinInstnId/BICFI.

TargetMessage.MT910_Specific_Note: MT910-derived camt.054 always has: - Ntry/CdtDbtInd = CRDT - Ntry/NtryDtls/TxDtls/CdtDbtInd = CRDT (BOTH levels mandatory) - Ntry/NtryRef = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory new field, fixed value) - Ntry/Sts/Cd = BOOK (mandatory new field, fixed value) - Ntry/BkTxCd/Prtry/Cd = "NOTPROVIDED" (mandatory new field, fixed value) - RltdAgts/CdtrAgt (not DbtrAgt) for the ordering institution

General.BusinessRationale: Field :20: populates both GrpHdr/MsgId and Ntfctn/Id — same pattern as MT900 conversion.
General.AuditRequirement: All notifications logged for AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: MsgId and Ntfctn/Id mandatory per camt.054 schema.
General.MigrationNote: Identical pattern to MT900 MAPPING_01 — MT910 field :20: is functionally the same reference field.
General.CachingStrategy: Processed references cached for duplicate detection.

General.BusinessRationale: Mandatory camt.054 header field. No MT910 equivalent.
General.AuditRequirement: Conversion timestamp logged for SLA measurement.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Mandatory per camt.054 schema. UTC per CBPR+.
General.MigrationNote: Same as MT900 MAPPING_02 — generated fresh at conversion time.

MappingFormula.Expression: if(isIBAN(MT.F25)) Ntfctn.Acct.Id.IBAN = MT.F25; else Ntfctn.Acct.Id.Othr.Id = MT.F25

Condition.ElseAction: REJECT SECURITY "SEC001: Account not authorized for recipient"

General.ImpactIfFails: Notification for wrong account — reconciliation failure and unauthorized financial data disclosure.
General.BusinessRationale: Account identification is the primary key linking notification to the correct nostro ledger. Same logic as MT900.
General.PerformanceImpact: LOW — IBAN regex + modulo-97 + authorization lookup (~6ms)
General.AuditRequirement: Account ID and authorization result logged. Retention: AUDIT_RETENTION_YEARS years.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Account authorization per banking secrecy laws and GDPR Article 5.
General.DataPrivacy: Account number is financial confidential data. AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3+ in transit.
General.MigrationNote: Identical logic to MT900 MAPPING_03 — account is credited rather than debited but identification logic is the same.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: Ntry.Amt = decimal(MT.F32A.amount.replace(",",".")) Ntry.CdtDbtInd = "CRDT" Ntry.ValDt.Dt = expandCentury(MT.F32A.date, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR) TxDtls.Amt = decimal(MT.F32A.amount.replace(",",".")) TxDtls.CdtDbtInd = "CRDT" TxDtls.RltdDts.IntrBkSttlmDt = expandCentury(MT.F32A.date, "yyMMdd", CENTURY_CUTOFF_YEAR)

Condition.ElseAction: ALERT treasury AND PROCEED — warning not rejection

General.ImpactIfFails: Complete notification failure — amount and value date are core financial data.
General.BusinessRationale: Same 6-path composite extraction as MT900, but CdtDbtInd = CRDT throughout instead of DBIT. Field :32A: populates Ntry/Amt+Ccy, Ntry/ValDt/Dt, TxDtls/Amt+Ccy, and TxDtls/RltdDts/IntrBkSttlmDt.
General.AuditRequirement: Amount, currency, date, and both CdtDbtInd values logged. Large credit alerts logged separately.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Accurate credit reporting for Basel III LCR (BCBS 248). CdtDbtInd correctness critical.
General.DataPrivacy: Transaction amounts are financial confidential data.
General.MigrationNote: Identical structure to MT900 MAPPING_04 but with CRDT fixed value instead of DBIT — this is the only functional difference.
General.CachingStrategy: No caching — parsed fresh from each MT910.

MappingFormula.PseudoCode: ref = (MT.F21 == "NONREF") ? "NOTPROVIDED" : MT.F21.trim() Refs.InstrId = ref Refs.EndToEndId = ref

General.ImpactIfFails: Automated reconciliation impossible — cannot match credit notification to original payment.
General.BusinessRationale: Same dual-population logic as MT900 MAPPING_05: field :21: maps to both InstrId and EndToEndId.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Transaction traceability per FATF Travel Rule.
General.MigrationNote: Identical to MT900 MAPPING_05 — NONREF → NOTPROVIDED convention applies equally.

General.ImpactIfFails: camt.054 schema validation failure — NtryRef, Sts, and BkTxCd are mandatory elements.
General.BusinessRationale: Same three mandatory new fields as MT900 — no MT910 equivalent exists for any of them.
General.AuditRequirement: Fixed values logged as part of standard camt.054 generation audit.
General.ComplianceRequirement: camt.054.001.08 XSD requires these three elements.
General.MigrationNote: Identical to MT900 MAPPING_06 — Sts/Cd=BOOK applies equally since MT910 also confirms completed booked entries.

General.ImpactIfFails: Ordering institution missing from camt.054 — payment chain incomplete but notification still delivered.
General.BusinessRationale: MT910 field :52A: identifies the institution that sent the funds resulting in this credit — maps to CdtrAgt (not DbtrAgt, as used in the MT900 mapping) since this is a credit notification.
General.AuditRequirement: Ordering institution BIC logged when present.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Institutional sanctions screening if BIC present.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No PII.
General.MigrationNote: KEY DIFFERENCE from MT900: target path uses RltdAgts/CdtrAgt (not DbtrAgt) — semantically correct for a credit notification where :52A: represents the crediting counterpart institution.

General.ImpactIfFails: Loss of supplemental information — notification still delivered.
General.BusinessRationale: Same as MT900 MAPPING_08 — full content preservation to AddtlTxInf.
General.AuditRequirement: Full :72: content preserved in camt.054 for audit completeness.
General.ComplianceRequirement: AML content screening per bank policy.
General.DataPrivacy: May contain payment narrative with PII references.

General.ImpactIfFails: Booking timestamp absent from camt.054. Optional field — notification still valid.
General.BusinessRationale: Same as MT900 MAPPING_09 — optional precise booking timestamp.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Same BoA guideline as MT900 — booking date mandatory when status=BOOK and available.
General.MigrationNote: Identical parsing logic to MT900 MAPPING_09.

General.ImpactIfFails: Ordering customer name missing from camt.054 — notification still delivered.
General.BusinessRationale: MT910 field :50K: identifies the customer that originated the underlying payment being confirmed as credited.
General.AuditRequirement: Ordering customer name logged when present.
General.DataPrivacy: Customer name is PII — handle per data protection policy.
General.MigrationNote: Uses Cdtr (not Dbtr) to stay consistent with MAPPING_07's CdtrAgt convention for the same underlying counterpart.

General.ImpactIfFails: Intermediary institution missing from camt.054 — notification still delivered.
General.BusinessRationale: MT910 field :56A: identifies an intermediary bank in the underlying interbank transfer chain.
General.ComplianceRequirement: Institutional sanctions screening if BIC present.
General.DataPrivacy: BIC is public identifier. No PII.
General.MigrationNote: Uses IntrmyAgt1, a directionally-neutral ISO 20022 element name, so no Dbtr/Cdtr-side ambiguity applies here.
